_meta.type_rationale: FCF compounder — FCF margin 28.4%; DCF methods prioritised
_meta.method_explanation: Free cash flow compounders are businesses that consistently generate more cash than they need to run the business — think of companies like consumer goods brands or software firms with subscription revenue. For these companies, that calculation gives a meaningful and trustworthy answer.
